entries.lead: Linux VM memory is reported and bounded
entries.text: The heavy-work watchdog, make heavy-status and the sentinel now report the Linux VM's memory as its own line, attributed to the run that booted it. It is never added to the shared budget, but a run whose VM exceeds BENCHBOX_HEAVY_VM_ALLOWANCE_GIB (default the machine's configured memory plus 10%) is stopped so the wrapper stops the machine.
